title: Rabbit Toys
description: It does not replace advice from a rabbit-savvy vet. If your rabbit stops eating, stops pooing, seems in pain or is suddenly unwell, contact a vet…
body:
<div class="wp-block-group alignfull">
<!--
RabbitCare.co.uk blog article block
Page: Rabbit Toys
How to use in WordPress:
1) Edit the blog page/post.
2) Add a "Custom HTML" block.
3) Replace the old article content with everything below.

Notes:
- No custom header/nav or footer included.
- Internal links use root-relative URLs.
- Uses the same visual style as the RabbitCare homepage.
- Images are reused as placeholders and can be changed later.
-->

<section class="rct-page alignfull" id="rabbit-toys">
  <style>
    :root {
      --rc-cream: #fff9ef;
      --rc-cream-2: #f6ead8;
      --rc-sage: #7f9b72;
      --rc-sage-dark: #4e6b45;
      --rc-moss: #2f4a2e;
      --rc-brown: #8a6246;
      --rc-gold: #d7a64b;
      --rc-charcoal: #2d2d2b;
      --rc-muted: #6f6a61;
      --rc-white: #ffffff;
      --rc-danger: #9b3b2f;
      --rc-danger-soft: #fff0eb;
      --rc-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.16);
      --rc-radius-xl: 34px;
      --rc-radius-lg: 24px;
      --rc-radius-md: 16px;
      --rc-max: 1180px;
      --rc-font-heading: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
      --rc-font-body: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    }

    .rct-page,
    .rct-page * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    body,
    .wp-site-blocks,
    .entry-content,
    .wp-block-post-content,
    main {
      background: #fef4f0 !important;
    }

    body .wp-site-blocks,
    body .entry-content,
    body .wp-block-post-content,
    body main,
    body article,
    body .wp-block-group,
    body .wp-block-post-content > .wp-block-html {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      gap: 0 !important;
      row-gap: 0 !important;
    }

    body .entry-header,
    body .page-header,
    body .wp-block-post-title,
    body h1.wp-block-post-title,
    body .wp-block-post-featured-image {
      display: none !important;
    }

    body .wp-site-blocks > * + *,
    body .entry-content > * + *,
    body .wp-block-post-content > * + * {
      margin-block-start: 0 !important;
    }

    body .wp-block-html,
    body .entry-content > .wp-block-html,
    body .wp-block-post-content > .wp-block-html {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      margin-bottom: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      padding-bottom: 0 !important;
    }

    .rct-page {
      position: relative;
      left: calc(50% + 20px);
      width: calc(100vw + 40px);
      max-width: none;
      margin: -120px 0 0 !important;
      padding: 0 !important;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      font-family: var(--rc-font-body);
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.18), transparent 32rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, var(--rc-cream) 0%, #fffdf8 46%, #fef4f0 100%);
      overflow-x: hidden;
      line-height: 1.68;
    }

    .rct-page a {
      color: inherit;
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    .rct-page a:focus-visible {
      outline: 3px solid rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.9);
      outline-offset: 4px;
      border-radius: 10px;
    }

    .rct-wrap {
      width: min(var(--rc-max), calc(100% - 34px));
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .rct-narrow {
      width: min(920px, calc(100% - 34px));
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .rct-pill {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 0.84rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .rct-pill::before {
      content: "✦";
      color: var(--rc-gold);
    }

    .rct-btns {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 14px;
      align-items: center;
      margin-top: 30px;
    }

    .rct-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      min-height: 52px;
      padding: 14px 22px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-weight: 900;
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease, background 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rct-btn:hover {
      transform: translateY(-3px);
    }

    .rct-btn-primary {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--rc-sage-dark), var(--rc-sage));
      color: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 18px 38px rgba(79, 112, 70, 0.26);
    }

    .rct-btn-secondary {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86);
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.16);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rct-hero {
      padding: 0 0 42px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 20%, rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.18), transparent 28rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #fff9ef 0%, rgba(255, 249, 239, 0) 100%);
    }

    .rct-hero-image-wrap {
      width: 100%;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      background: #fff9ef;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rct-hero-cover {
      position: relative;
      width: 100%;
      margin-top: 0;
    }

    .rct-hero-cover::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background:
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.68), rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.24) 45%, rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.04)),
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18), transparent 45%, rgba(255, 249, 239, 0.12));
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .rct-hero-image {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      object-fit: contain;
      object-position: center;
      background: #fff;
      animation: rctFadeIn 0.9s ease both;
    }

    .rct-hero-title-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 2;
      left: max(24px, calc((100vw - var(--rc-max)) / 2));
      bottom: clamp(28px, 8vw, 96px);
      max-width: 760px;
      padding: clamp(20px, 4vw, 38px);
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .rct-hero-title-overlay .rct-pill {
      color: #ffffff;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    }

    .rct-hero-title-overlay h1 {
      margin: 12px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 7rem);
      line-height: 0.88;
      letter-spacing: -0.065em;
      color: #ffffff;
      text-wrap: balance;
      text-shadow: 0 5px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.42);
    }

    .rct-hero-title-overlay p {
      max-width: 560px;
      margin: 0;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94);
      font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 2vw, 1.35rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.36);
    }

    .rct-hero-content {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.05fr 0.95fr;
      gap: 34px;
      align-items: center;
      padding-top: 44px;
    }

    .rct-breadcrumb {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .rct-breadcrumb a {
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
    }

    .rct-intro-heading {
      margin: 12px 0 16px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4.4rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.055em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rct-hero-subtitle {
      max-width: 720px;
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: clamp(1.08rem, 2vw, 1.28rem);
    }

    .rct-hero-card {
      padding: 28px;
      border-radius: 38px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.84);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    }

    .rct-hero-card h2 {
      margin: 0 0 14px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.35rem;
      line-height: 1.18;
    }

    .rct-hero-card ul {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rct-hero-card li {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 32px 1fr;
      gap: 10px;
      align-items: start;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .rct-hero-card li::before {
      content: "✓";
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .rct-quickbar {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 4;
      margin-top: 26px;
    }

    .rct-quickbar-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 14px;
      padding: 16px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    }

    .rct-quick {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 62px 1fr;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      min-height: 96px;
      padding: 18px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff, #fff8eb);
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rct-quick:hover {
      transform: translateY(-5px);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(83, 61, 42, 0.14);
    }

    .rct-quick-icon {
      width: 62px;
      height: 62px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      font-size: 2.35rem;
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .rct-quick strong {
      display: block;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      line-height: 1.15;
      font-size: 1.02rem;
    }

    .rct-quick span span {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 4px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      line-height: 1.35;
    }

    .rct-section {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 72px 0;
      position: relative;
    }

    .rct-section-header {
      max-width: 780px;
      margin: 0 auto 32px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .rct-section h2,
    .rct-final h2 {
      margin: 12px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4.6rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.055em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rct-section-header p {
      margin: 0 auto;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.08rem;
      max-width: 680px;
    }

    .rct-article-layout {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 320px;
      gap: 28px;
      align-items: start;
    }

    .rct-content {
      display: grid;
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .rct-panel {
      position: relative;
      padding: clamp(24px, 4vw, 38px);
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 18px 48px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rct-panel::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      width: 190px;
      height: 190px;
      right: -82px;
      top: -92px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.10);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .rct-panel > * {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .rct-panel h2 {
      margin-top: 0;
    }

    .rct-panel h3 {
      margin: 0 0 10px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.45rem;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .rct-panel p {
      margin: 0 0 16px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.03rem;
    }

    .rct-panel p:last-child {
      margin-bottom: 0;
    }

    .rct-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 22px 0 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rct-list li {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 38px 1fr;
      gap: 12px;
      align-items: start;
      padding: 15px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: rgba(255, 249, 239, 0.86);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.10);
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .rct-list li::before {
      content: "✓";
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 38px;
      height: 38px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .rct-toy-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 24px;
    }

    .rct-toy-card {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 280px;
      padding: 24px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.10);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rct-toy-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-6px);
      box-shadow: 0 24px 58px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.15);
    }

    .rct-toy-icon {
      display: inline-grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 62px;
      height: 62px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      border-radius: 22px;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.13);
      font-size: 2rem;
    }

    .rct-toy-card h3 {
      margin: 0 0 10px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.32rem;
    }

    .rct-toy-card p {
      margin: 0 0 16px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
    }

    .rct-mini-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 9px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rct-mini-list li {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      align-items: flex-start;
      color: #4b453c;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 750;
    }

    .rct-mini-list li::before {
      content: "•";
      color: var(--rc-gold);
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .rct-image-split {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.95fr 1.05fr;
      gap: 30px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .rct-image-card {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 430px;
    }

    .rct-image-card img {
      position: absolute;
      object-fit: cover;
      display: block;
      border: 10px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      transition: transform 0.35s ease;
    }

    .rct-image-card img:hover {
      transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1.03) !important;
    }

    .rct-img-main {
      width: 78%;
      height: 340px;
      left: 0;
      top: 20px;
      border-radius: 42px;
      transform: rotate(-2deg);
    }

    .rct-img-small {
      width: 52%;
      height: 230px;
      right: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      border-radius: 34px;
      transform: rotate(4deg);
    }

    .rct-safety {
      padding: 68px 0;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 240, 235, 0.56), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0));
    }

    .rct-safety-card {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.9fr 1.1fr;
      gap: 28px;
      align-items: center;
      padding: clamp(24px, 5vw, 44px);
      border-radius: 42px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 2px solid rgba(155, 59, 47, 0.16);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
    }

    .rct-safety-card h2 {
      color: var(--rc-danger);
    }

    .rct-safety-card p {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.06rem;
    }

    .rct-avoid-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rct-avoid-list li {
      padding: 18px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: var(--rc-danger-soft);
      color: #4a2823;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .rct-avoid-list strong {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
      color: var(--rc-danger);
      font-size: 1.05rem;
    }

    .rct-steps-section {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0), rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.09), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0));
    }

    .rct-steps {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }

    .rct-step {
      padding: 24px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.84);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rct-step b {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.15);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 1.15rem;
    }

    .rct-step h3 {
      margin: 0 0 8px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.22rem;
    }

    .rct-step p {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
    }

    .rct-sidebar {
      position: sticky;
      top: 22px;
      display: grid;
      gap: 18px;
    }

    .rct-side-card {
      padding: 22px;
      border-radius: 28px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rct-side-card h2 {
      margin: 0 0 14px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.18rem;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .rct-side-card ul {
      display: grid;
      gap: 10px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rct-side-card a {
      display: block;
      padding: 11px 12px;
      border-radius: 16px;
      background: #fff9ef;
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 850;
      transition: transform 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease;
    }

    .rct-side-card a:hover {
      transform: translateX(4px);
      background: #fff4d8;
    }

    .rct-note {
      padding: 20px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border-left: 6px solid var(--rc-gold);
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.08);
    }

    .rct-note strong {
      color: var(--rc-moss);
    }

    .rct-related {
      padding: 74px 0;
      background: #fff9ef;
      opacity: 1 !important;
      transform: none !important;
      animation: none !important;
    }

    .rct-related,
    .rct-related * {
      opacity: 1 !important;
      filter: none !important;
      text-shadow: none !important;
    }

    .rct-related .rct-section-header {
      padding: 30px;
      border-radius: 34px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 2px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.22);
      box-shadow: 0 20px 54px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.14);
    }

    .rct-related .rct-section-header .rct-pill {
      color: #4e6b45 !important;
    }

    .rct-related .rct-section-header h2 {
      color: #243320 !important;
      opacity: 1 !important;
      text-shadow: none !important;
    }

    .rct-related .rct-section-header p {
      color: #332d26 !important;
      opacity: 1 !important;
      text-shadow: none !important;
      font-weight: 650;
    }

    .rct-related-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }

    .rct-related-card {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 92px 1fr;
      gap: 15px;
      padding: 16px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: #ffffff !important;
      border: 2px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.22);
      box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.15);
      transition: transform 0.22s ease, background 0.22s ease;
    }

    .rct-related-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-5px);
      background: #fff;
    }

    .rct-related-card img {
      width: 92px;
      height: 92px;
      max-width: 92px;
      max-height: 92px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      object-fit: cover;
      background: #f1eadf;
    }

    .rct-related-card h3 {
      margin: 4px 0 6px;
      color: #243320 !important;
      line-height: 1.15;
      font-size: 1.08rem;
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .rct-related-card p {
      margin: 0;
      color: #332d26 !important;
      font-size: 0.92rem;
      line-height: 1.45;
      font-weight: 650;
    }

    .rct-final {
      padding: 70px 0 42px;
      background: #fef4f0;
    }

    .rct-final-box {

            <li>Swap toys every few days to make the play area feel fresh.</li>
            <li>Move tunnels, boxes and hideouts around to encourage exploring.</li>
            <li>Remove any damaged toys before they become unsafe.</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="rct-safety rct-reveal" id="safety-tips" aria-label="Rabbit toy safety tips">
      <div class="rct-wrap rct-safety-card">
        <div>
          <span class="rct-pill">Toy safety</span>
          <h2>Safety tips for rabbit toys</h2>
          <p>
            Always make sure your rabbit’s toys are safe. Rabbits may chew, dig, toss or pull apart their toys, so choosing safe materials is important.
          </p>
        </div>

        <ul class="rct-avoid-list">
          <li>
            <strong>Avoid small loose pieces</strong>
            Remove toys with tiny parts that could be swallowed or cause choking.
          </li>

          <li>
            <strong>Avoid toxic or treated materials</strong>
            Do not use treated wood, painted items, unsafe glue, toxic plants or unknown materials.
          </li>

          <li>
            <strong>Remove damaged toys</strong>
            Check toys regularly and throw away anything sharp, broken, mouldy or heavily chewed.
          </li>

          <li>
            <strong>Supervise new toys</strong>
            Watch your rabbit when introducing something new so you can see how they use it.
          </li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="rct-section rct-reveal" id="enjoying-toys">
      <div class="rct-narrow">
        <div class="rct-panel">
          <span class="rct-pill">Playful behaviour</span>
          <h2>Signs your rabbit is enjoying their toys</h2>
          <p>
            When rabbits are happy and entertained, they often show playful behaviours. Every rabbit is different, so your rabbit may have favourite activities they return to again and again.
          </p>

          <ul class="rct-list">
            <li>Tossing toys around with their teeth.</li>
            <li>Digging in toy boxes or paper-filled areas.</li>
            <li>Chewing sticks, balls or hay-based toys.</li>
            <li>Exploring tunnels, boxes and hideouts.</li>
            <li>Returning to the same toy or play area regularly.</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>


    <section class="rct-section rct-faq rct-reveal" id="faq">
      <div class="rct-narrow">
        <div class="rct-section-header">
          <span class="rct-pill">FAQs</span>
          <h2>Rabbit toy questions</h2>
          <p>Quick answers about safe toys, DIY enrichment and keeping your rabbit interested.</p>
        </div>

        <div class="rct-faq-list">
          <details class="rct-faq-item">
            <summary>What toys are best for rabbits?</summary>
            <p>The best rabbit toys encourage natural behaviour, such as chewing, digging, hiding, foraging, tossing and exploring. Good options include untreated wooden chew toys, willow balls, hay toys, tunnels, cardboard boxes, digging boxes and safe hideouts.</p>
          </details>

          <details class="rct-faq-item">
            <summary>Are cardboard boxes safe for rabbits?</summary>
            <p>Plain cardboard boxes can be useful rabbit toys when they are clean, dry and free from tape, staples, plastic, glossy coatings and unsafe ink. Remove cardboard if it becomes soggy, mouldy, sharp or heavily chewed.</p>
          </details>

          <details class="rct-faq-item">
            <summary>Do rabbits need chew toys?</summary>
            <p>Yes. Rabbits naturally need to chew, and safe chew toys can help keep them occupied while supporting normal chewing behaviour. Hay should still be the main way rabbits wear their teeth down, but chew toys are useful enrichment.</p>
          </details>

          <details class="rct-faq-item">
            <summary>How often should I rotate rabbit toys?</summary>
            <p>Try rotating toys every few days so the play area stays interesting. You do not need to change everything at once; simply swapping tunnels, boxes, chew toys and forage activities can make familiar toys feel new again.</p>
          </details>

          <details class="rct-faq-item">
            <summary>What toys should rabbits avoid?</summary>
            <p>Avoid toys made from treated wood, toxic plants, unsafe glue, sharp pieces, small swallowable parts, mouldy materials, painted items of unknown safety or anything your rabbit can break into dangerous fragments.</p>
          </details>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="rct-final rct-reveal">
      <div class="rct-wrap rct-final-box">
        <span class="rct-pill">Final thoughts</span>
        <h2>Rabbit toys are essential for a happy, active rabbit</h2>
        <p>
          Toys are an essential part of keeping rabbits happy and mentally stimulated. By providing chew toys, digging boxes, tunnels, hideouts and interactive play items, you can create a more enriching environment for your rabbit.
        </p>
        <p>
          Rotating toys and offering new activities regularly will keep your rabbit curious and entertained. A rabbit with enough enrichment is more likely to stay healthy, active and content.
        </p>
